title: RISC-V Unprivileged ISA (ratified, v20260120), RV32I: JAL/JALR write the return address
note: 'JAL stores the address of the instruction following the jump ('pc'+4) into register rd.' RA therefore points after the call.

title: GNU Binutils manual, addr2line (output format of -a -f -i -p -C)
note: '??' for unknown file or function, 0 for unknown line; with -p -i inlined callers follow on lines prefixed '(inlined by)'.

title: System V ABI (gABI), ELF header e_machine values
note: EM_XTENSA = 94, EM_RISCV = 243; used to tell Xtensa from RISC-V ELF files.
